notes.title: New build with 2nd round of Open Beta bugfixes
notes.content:
Today we've updated the Brass build to include the 2nd round of bug-fixes and improvements reported during Open Beta.

Here is the change log:

- Add support for full size map
- Add support for email notifications for online game
- Fixed scrolling mask
- Fixed rulebook animations
- Fixed issues with sell cotton action

notes.title: New build with 1st round of Open Beta bugfixes
notes.content:
Today we've updated the Brass build to include 1st round of bug-fixes and improvements reported during Open Beta. 

Here is the change log:

- Add support to keyboard scrolling
- Add keyboard support to dismiss popups
- Improved German localisation
- Fixed hat that was getting huge
- Fixed mouse over labels in Wigan
- Fixed missing spaces in some texts
- Fixed misplaced tutorial finger animation
